Marcus — reviewed the attached MSA (Nova_MSA_v1.2.pdf). Initial redline notes below; I attached an annotated PDF (redline_MSA_nova_annotated.pdf).

Top items we should propose:
1) Data security / confidentiality (Section 6) — request explicit encryption-at-rest + in-transit language, and a warranty tied to our SOC 2 compliance. Suggest adding: "Redwood warrants that it maintains SOC 2 Type II controls relevant to the Services; copies of the report are available under NDA."
2) Limitation of Liability (Section 11) — they proposed unlimited liability for certain paragraph; propose cap at 2x fees and carveouts for gross negligence/fraud only.
3) IP & Background/Foreground (Section 9) — clarify that Redwood retains model IP and customer gets license to use outputs; ensure no assignment of model ownership.

Questions for sales / prospect:
- Data residency: do they require EU-only or a specific region? Marcus — please confirm.
- Invoicing entity: confirm legal name for billing and whether they will submit a PO.
- Any regulatory clauses (e.g., HIPAA) we should be aware of?

I will prepare a tracked changes PDF and a short summary of the commercial asks (liability delta, termination rights) by EOD tomorrow. If this is time-sensitive, I can prioritize for a morning turnaround — let me know.

Attachments: redline_MSA_nova_annotated.pdf

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
